Recommend adding Briseno as a second candidate (pending final printed-ballot confirmation, which wasn't independently verified past the certified-write-in stage) and reconsidering the contested flag.

races.notes: Coverage method: started from the task's candidate district lists, then verified each district's overlap with the City of LA using Wikipedia district-profile city lists (cross-checked against the CA SOS 2026 primary statement-of-vote XLSX files and, where available, the LA County RR/CC consolidated results page at results.lavote.gov/text-results/4338, election=4338 — the same source/ID used by the sibling la-general.json lane). Included 10 of 20 candidate Assembly districts and 4 of 9 candidate Senate districts as substantially overlapping the City of LA. SKIPPED (Assembly, no City-of-LA overlap found): AD39 (Antelope Valley/High Desert — Lancaster, Palmdale, Adelanto, Victorville, Hesperia), AD41 (Pasadena-anchored foothill communities — Altadena, La Cañada Flintridge, Sierra Madre, Rancho Cucamonga/Upland), AD42 (Inland Empire/California desert), AD44 (Burbank/Glendale-based per available sources; could not confirm a City-of-LA portion — flagged for follow-up rather than assumed), AD48 (eastern San Gabriel Valley — Azusa, Baldwin Park, Covina, El Monte, West Covina), AD53 (Pomona/Montclair/Chino/Ontario/Upland), AD58 (Riverside/San Bernardino Inland Empire), AD59 (Orange County), AD64 (Bell, Bell Gardens, Cudahy, Downey, Norwalk, La Mirada, La Habra — no LA city portion in SOV county breakdown), AD65 (Orange County — Anaheim, Buena Park, Cypress, Fullerton, Garden Grove). SKIPPED (Senate): SD18 (San Diego/Imperial County border), SD22 (San Gabriel/Pomona Valley plus San Bernardino County), SD30 (Gateway Cities — Downey, Norwalk, Bellflower, Whittier — no LA city portion). SD33 and SD35 were on the task's candidate list but are ODD-numbered districts; the CA SOS 2026 primary explicitly covers 'State Senator by District (even-numbered districts only)' this cycle, so neither was on the November 2026 ballot at all (this is separate from the geography question — SD33 is ~0.9% City-of-LA/mostly Long Beach and SD35 is ~6.2% City-of-LA/Watts-San Pedro per Wikipedia, for reference if a future odd-year cycle needs them). Also note: AD54 and AD61 show as unopposed (100%) in the LA County RR/CC breakdown but carry small named write-in vote totals in the CA SOS statewide SOV not reflected in the county breakdown; flagged UNVERIFIED on those two race entries rather than resolved here.
races.verify_notes: coverage note, not a race. AD44 verdict (per task): independent sources (a syndicated LAist/Yahoo district guide and Ballotpedia's community list for CA Assembly District 44) confirm AD44 DOES include City of Los Angeles territory — a Sunland-Tujunga/Lake View Terrace/Shadow Hills foothill corridor and a separate North Hollywood/Toluca Lake/Studio City/Sherman Oaks pocket — alongside its Burbank/Glendale core (cross-checked to make sure this wasn't confused with neighboring AD46, which covers a distinct non-overlapping west-Valley area). The 'flagged for follow-up' item should be resolved as confirmed-overlap, not left unconfirmed.
